items.title: Build a data foundation for agentic AI on AWS: From lakehouse to MCP
items.summary: Building a data foundation ready for agentic AI relies on a unified lakehouse and interoperability protocols like Model Context Protocol (MCP). This post walks through four pillars for building an agentic AI data foundation on AWS: a unified lakehouse, context engineering, multi-agent interoperability, and data governance.
items.creator: Adrien Lebret
